description: Every 15 minutes, reads the new emails in the owner’s Gmail: the Inbox, any other folders (or Gmail labels) listed in Bookkeeping setup, and each client’s own mail folder. Carries on from where the last run stopped, so none are missed. AI picks out supplier bills, the clients’ own sales invoices, statements and requests to raise an invoice; each attachment is checked, so terms and conditions or a remittance sent with a bill are left alone. Several photos become one PDF (an iPhone’s HEIC photos are converted). Each bill is filed in its client’s Bookkeeping Inbox folder (by its mail folder, or by the names, trading names and ABN on it), where Process bill takes over. A bill with nothing readable attached (a link to view it online) becomes a WorkQ item. Other emails are left untouched. Needs the Google Workspace extension, with Gmail connected by the automation’s owner.

# ── bookkeeping kit: shared helpers (inlined into each node by gen-ext.js) ──
import json
import re
import datetime
import hashlib
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo

# Knowledge layout. Folders may nest at most 2 levels, so inbox folders are top-level.
BK_SETTINGS = "Bookkeeping/settings.json"
BK_CLIENTS = "Bookkeeping/Clients"
BK_RULES = "Bookkeeping/Rules"
BK_BILLS = "Bookkeeping/Bills"
BK_INBOX = "Bookkeeping Inbox"
BK_PROCESSED = "Bookkeeping Processed"
BK_FAILED = "Bookkeeping Failed"
BK_MAIL = "Bookkeeping/Mail"
BK_REQUESTS = "Bookkeeping Requests"
BK_CHECKS = "Bookkeeping/Checks"
# One threshold for "needs a tax invoice / an ABN / an attachment": $75 excluding GST = $82.50 including GST.
BK_GST_INVOICE_LIMIT = 82.5


def bk_read_json(path, default=None):
    try:
        raw = api.files.read(file=path)
    except Exception:
        return default
    try:
        return json.loads(raw)
    except Exception:
        return default


# ── bookkeeping kit: mailbox adapter (inlined into email-intake nodes by gen-ext.js) ──
# Reads the automation owner's own mailbox (Outlook through m365-mail-read, a personal Hotmail / Outlook.com account
# through hotmail-mail, Gmail through google-workspace-gmail) or a shared Outlook mailbox (m365-mail-shared).
# Read-only: nothing in the mailbox is changed, so emails that aren't bills stay exactly as they were.
import base64
import hashlib
import html

MAIL_SERVER = {"outlook": "m365-mail-read", "outlook-shared": "m365-mail-shared", "hotmail": "hotmail-mail",
               "gmail": "google-workspace-gmail"}
MAIL_FIRST_RUN_HOURS = 24
# Emails handled per run (oldest first); the rest wait for the next run, which starts where this one stopped.
MAIL_PER_RUN = 20
MAIL_TRIAGE_BATCH = 10
MAIL_PHOTO_MIN_BYTES = 30000
MAIL_PHOTO_TYPES = (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp", ".gif", ".tif", ".tiff", ".heic", ".heif")
MAIL_PHOTO_MIMES = ("image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp", "image/gif", "image/tiff", "image/heic", "image/heif")
MAIL_GMAIL_PAGES = 10
# Outlook/Hotmail pages read past a full page of emails already handled (see mail_list).
MAIL_OUTLOOK_PAGES = 10
# The shared mailbox the outlook-shared intake reads (set by the node from the Bookkeeping settings).
MAIL_MAILBOX = {"address": ""}


def mail_call(provider, tool, **args):
    if provider == "outlook-shared":
        args["mailbox"] = MAIL_MAILBOX["address"]
    return api.connectors.invoke(server=MAIL_SERVER[provider], tool=tool, args=args)


def mail_is_outlook(provider):
    """Outlook-shaped (Microsoft Graph): a work Outlook mailbox, a shared one, or a personal Hotmail / Outlook.com one.
    hotmail-mail has the same tools and answers as m365-mail-read, without shared mailboxes."""
    return provider in ("outlook", "outlook-shared", "hotmail")


def mail_is_pdf(att):
    name = str(att.get("name") or att.get("filename") or "").lower()
    ctype = str(att.get("contentType") or att.get("mimeType") or "").lower()
    return ((name.endswith(".pdf") or ctype == "application/pdf") and not att.get("isInline")
            and str(att.get("kind") or "file") == "file")


def mail_is_photo(att):
    """A photographed bill: an image file attachment (JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, TIFF or an iPhone's HEIC), big enough not to
    be a logo or a signature image."""
    name = str(att.get("name") or att.get("filename") or "").lower()
    ctype = str(att.get("contentType") or att.get("mimeType") or "").lower()
    return ((name.endswith(MAIL_PHOTO_TYPES) or ctype in MAIL_PHOTO_MIMES) and not att.get("isInline")
            and str(att.get("kind") or "file") == "file" and int(att.get("size") or 0) >= MAIL_PHOTO_MIN_BYTES)


def mail_attachments(provider, msg_id):
    """The email's file attachments: {"pdfs": [...], "photos": [...], "other": [names]}, each pdf or photo as
    {id, name, size}. Photos (a bill photographed on a phone) count only when there's no PDF, so a logo or a picture of
    the job sent with an invoice isn't read as a bill. "other" names attachments that can't be read (Word, Excel…)."""
    if mail_is_outlook(provider):
        rows = mail_call(provider, "list_email_attachments", id=msg_id)
        if isinstance(rows, dict):
            rows = rows.get("attachments") or rows.get("value") or []
        rows = [{"id": str(a["id"]), "name": str(a.get("name") or ""), "size": a.get("size") or 0, "raw": a}
                for a in rows or [] if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("id")]
    else:
        msg = mail_call(provider, "get_message", id=msg_id)
        rows = [{"id": str(a["attachmentId"]), "name": str(a.get("filename") or ""), "size": a.get("size") or 0, "raw": a}
                for a in (msg.get("attachments") if isinstance(msg, dict) else []) or []
                if isinstance(a, dict) and a.get("attachmentId")]
    pdfs = [{"id": r["id"], "name": r["name"] or "bill.pdf", "size": r["size"]} for r in rows if mail_is_pdf(r["raw"])]
    photos = [{"id": r["id"], "name": r["name"] or "photo.jpg", "size": r["size"]} for r in rows if mail_is_photo(r["raw"])]
    other = [r["name"] for r in rows if r["name"] and not mail_is_pdf(r["raw"]) and not mail_is_photo(r["raw"])
             and not r["raw"].get("isInline") and str(r["raw"].get("kind") or "file") == "file"
             and not str(r["raw"].get("contentType") or r["raw"].get("mimeType") or "").lower().startswith("image/")]
    return {"pdfs": pdfs, "photos": [] if pdfs else photos, "other": other}


def mail_shared_mailbox(settings):
    return str(((settings or {}).get("intake") or {}).get("shared_mailbox") or "").strip()


# ── Pick out the bills ──


TRIAGE_PROMPT = (
    "You triage an Australian bookkeeper's inbox. For each email, decide whether it is work to pick up. Kinds: "
    "\"supplier bill\" (its PDF, or a photo of it, is a bill the business has to pay); \"sales invoice\" (its PDF is an invoice the "
    "business itself issued to one of its customers, sent or copied to the bookkeeper to record); \"invoice request\" "
    "(the business asks the bookkeeper to raise and send a new invoice to one of its customers, e.g. \"please invoice "
    "Bayview for 12 hours in September\"); \"bank statement\" (its PDF is a bank or credit card statement for the "
    "business's account); \"statement of account\" (its PDF is a statement of account from a supplier, or one the business "
    "sent its customer); or \"other\". Set capture true for those five kinds, also when the bill has no attachment and "
    "the email only links to it online (\"your bill is ready, view it here\"). These are \"other\": remittance advices, receipts for something already paid, quotes, purchase orders, credit "
    "notes, payment reminders whose PDF isn't the invoice itself, newsletters and marketing, questions and any other "
    "work. Judge from the subject, sender, preview text and attachment names. Give a short reason for each."
)
TRIAGE_HINT = '[{"index": 0, "kind": "supplier bill", "capture": true, "reason": ""}]'

provider = params["provider"]
problem = params.get("problem") or ""
bills = []
requests = []
unreadable = []
skipped = []
if not problem:
    MAIL_MAILBOX["address"] = mail_shared_mailbox(bk_read_json(BK_SETTINGS) or {})
    looked = []
    for m in params.get("candidates") or []:
        files = {"pdfs": [], "photos": [], "other": []}
        if m.get("has_attachments"):
            try:
                files = mail_attachments(provider, m["id"])
            except Exception as exc:
                skipped.append({"id": m["id"], "print": m.get("print") or "", "folder": m.get("folder") or "inbox",
                                "at": m.get("at") or 0, "outcome": "error",
                                "reason": "Couldn't read the attachments: " + str(exc)[:200]})
                continue
        looked.append(dict(m, pdfs=files["pdfs"] or files["photos"], photos=bool(files["photos"]), other=files["other"]))
    # A batch of emails per AI call, so a long run never overflows the AI's input.
    for start in range(0, len(looked), MAIL_TRIAGE_BATCH):
        batch = looked[start:start + MAIL_TRIAGE_BATCH]
        verdicts = api.ai.extract(
            prompt=TRIAGE_PROMPT,
            input=json.dumps([{"index": i, "subject": m["subject"], "from": m["from"], "preview": m["preview"][:800],
                               "attachments": [p["name"] for p in m["pdfs"]] + m["other"]} for i, m in enumerate(batch)])[:20000],
            schema_hint=TRIAGE_HINT,
        )
        by_index = {}
        for v in verdicts if isinstance(verdicts, list) else []:
            if isinstance(v, dict) and isinstance(v.get("index"), (int, float)):
                by_index[int(v["index"])] = v
        for i, m in enumerate(batch):
            v = by_index.get(i)
            base = {"id": m["id"], "print": m.get("print") or "", "folder": m.get("folder") or "inbox", "at": m.get("at") or 0}
            if v is None:
                # No verdict (the AI call failed or skipped it): try again on the next run.
                skipped.append(dict(base, outcome="error", reason="The AI didn't triage this email"))
                continue
            kind = str(v.get("kind") or "").lower()
            capture = v.get("capture", v.get("is_bill"))
            reason = str(v.get("reason") or "")
            if capture and "request" in kind:
                requests.append(dict(m, kind="invoice request", reason=reason))
            elif capture and m["pdfs"]:
                # Bills, sales invoices and statements all go to the client's inbox folder; Process works out which.
                bills.append(dict(m, kind=kind or "supplier bill", reason=reason))
            elif capture:
                # A bill with nothing readable attached: it links to the bill online, or sends a Word or Excel file.
                unreadable.append(dict(m, kind=kind or "supplier bill", reason=reason))
            else:
                skipped.append(dict(base, outcome="not_a_bill", reason=((kind or "other") + ": " + reason)[:200]))
